ability.name: Service and Port Enumeration
ability.description: Scans the top 1000 TCP ports on discovered live hosts to identify active services.

stages.command_template:
if not exist C:\Windows\Temp as mkdir C:\Windows\Temp as && powershell -Command "if (Test-Path 'C:\Windows\Temp as
map_hostsweep.gnmap') { $ips = Get-Content 'C:\Windows\Temp as
map_hostsweep.gnmap' | Where-Object { $_ -match 'Host: ([0-9.]+)' } | ForEach-Object { $Matches[1] } | Select-Object -Unique; if ($ips) { Set-Content -Path 'C:\Windows\Temp as\live_hosts.txt' -Value $ips } else { Set-Content -Path 'C:\Windows\Temp as\live_hosts.txt' -Value '192.168.187.161' } } else { Set-Content -Path 'C:\Windows\Temp as\live_hosts.txt' -Value '192.168.187.161' }" && nmap -sT -sV -Pn --top-ports 1000 --version-intensity 5 -oA C:\Windows\Temp as
map_services -iL C:\Windows\Temp as\live_hosts.txt

rationale: Performs service and version detection on the discovered live hosts to identify potential targets and domain controllers.
